The decisive mistake was in Step 1, by NumericalAlgorithms_Expert. The code used a tolerance test, `abs(x_n1 - x_n) < 1e-4`, and returned the loop index at the iteration that produced x_{n+1}. The task asks for the smallest n where x_n and x_{n+1} agree after rounding to four decimal places. Here x_2 ≈ -4.936105 and x_3 ≈ -4.9361048 both round to -4.9361, so the answer is n = 2. The tolerance test first passed at n = 3, which is the wrong criterion and an off-by-one in the reported index. Verification_Expert (Step 5) and NumericalMethods_Expert (Step 7) only checked that the printed iterates were consistent and did not test the rounding criterion, so they confirmed the error rather than catching it.
